findings.description: [Image 1: 00-zoom-activity.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Header overlap in left panel: The summary metric line ("4,364 commits · 20 events · 1409 PRs · 30d") renders directly on top of the inner panel header ("● EVENTS BY REPOSITORY"), colliding over the green status dot and title text.

[Image 1: 00-zoom-activity.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Bottom-left footer text collision: Two separate footer lines ("observed Nov 24, 2026 · 16:41 JST · rebuildup.dev" and "8 private repos · 1490 commits · 548 PRs (aggregated)") render at nearly the same y-coordinate, superimposing and rendering both the observation timestamp and private-repo aggregation note illegible.

[Image 1: 00-zoom-activity.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Right panel header and feed collisions: Row 1 ("■ ty-plus · PR #572" and "Nov 24, 2026 · 16:38 JST") collides directly on top of "● RECENT ACTIVITY". Across all 6 rows, repo/PR/issue labels horizontally overlap their timestamps (worst on row 4 where "tastile-root · Issue #158" heavily overlaps "Nov 24,"), and row 4's timestamp ("16:36 JST") directly collides with the panel's bottom-right "times in JST" label.

[Image 1: 00-zoom-activity.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Inner panel container overflow on both columns: The left rounded box terminates right through row 3 ("rebuildup/design-skills" / "2 ev", with "public activity only" crowding "2 ev"), leaving rows 4–7 and "+23 more repositories" spilling outside the box. The right rounded box ends at row 4, leaving rows 5–6 ("tastile-root · PR #159" x2) spilling outside the box.

[Image 1: 00-zoom-activity.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Ambiguous data presentation: "rebuildup/atcoder-kit" reports "0 ev" yet draws a green bar sliver; Recent Activity displays identical-looking consecutive rows ("herdr-t3 · PR #157" twice at 16:37 JST; "tastile-root · PR #159" twice at 16:36 JST) without action verbs (opened/merged/commented); and top-right window ("Oct 26 – Nov 25, 2026 · JST") ends one day ahead of the observed timestamp ("Nov 24, 2026 · 16:41 JST").

[Image 1: 00-zoom-activity.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Low contrast on smallest text: Muted slate text (event counts, timestamps, "+23 more repositories", and footer metadata) on the near-black background will be difficult to read at ~350–760px README width.

[Image 1: 00-zoom-activity.png | Verdict: REJECT | Opportunity] Honest-state metadata intent is solid ("public activity only", "times in JST", observation timestamp, private-repo aggregation note). Once box heights and text positions are fixed, add concise action verbs to feed items and suppress bars for 0-event rows.

[Image 2: 01-zoom-presence.png | Verdict: ACCEPT | Opportunity] Premature mid-word truncation: "Online — shipping the profile r..." clips mid-word despite noticeable unused horizontal space before "observed Nov 24, 2026 · 16:55 JST". Increasing the text width budget or ellipsizing at a word boundary would communicate the status more cleanly.

[Image 2: 01-zoom-presence.png | Verdict: ACCEPT | Opportunity] Card has zero overlaps, clearly communicates live Discord presence, and includes an explicit honest-state observation timestamp. Slightly brightening the muted slate timestamp ("observed Nov 24, 2026 · 16:55 JST") and adding a couple pixels between the Discord icon and green status dot would improve legibility at small README display sizes.

[Image 3: 02-zoom-current.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Bottom-left footer text collision: "+11 more on rebuildup.dev" overlaps vertically with the bottom line "as of 2026-11-24 · names and status lines are the owner's declarations", colliding across the top of "as of 2026-11-24 · names".

[Image 3: 02-zoom-current.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Missing required weight labels: The specification requires in-progress projects with weight labels, but no weight badges, tags, or indicators appear anywhere on the card, leaving the right ~60% empty.

[Image 3: 02-zoom-current.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Boilerplate subtitles contradict honest-state declaration: All four public items repeat the identical auto-generated Japanese text ("GitHub 上で活動が観測された公開リポジトリ。"), conveying no project-specific status and contradicting the footer statement that "names and status lines are the owner's declarations".

[Image 3: 02-zoom-current.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Small-text contrast and bottom spacing: Muted gray subtitles and the cramped footer at the bottom edge have borderline contrast and tight padding that hurt legibility at ~350–760px README width.

[Image 3: 02-zoom-current.png | Verdict: REJECT | Opportunity] Unify card language (currently mixes English headers/footer with Japanese subtitles and "非公開プロジェクト") and include observation time + timezone (JST) alongside "as of 2026-11-24" for consistency with cards 1 and 2.

[Image 4: 03-zoom-stats.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Missing/invisible stat rows and critically low contrast: Only "Total Stars Earned: 171" is faintly visible in ultra-pale gray on white (~1.2:1 contrast), while all subsequent GitHub stat rows (commits, PRs, issues, contributions) are completely invisible, leaving the lower-left blank. The "B+" ring arc is also partially under-filled (~28%). This appears caused by staggered SVG fade-in animations captured mid-transition (or broken opacity/styling).
[Image 4: 03-zoom-stats.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Missing honest-state elements: No observation timestamp, data time window, or stale/unavailable indicator is displayed.

[Image 4: 03-zoom-stats.png | Verdict: REJECT | Opportunity] Disable SVG animations (e.g., disable_animations=true) so all stat rows and the rank ring render immediately at full contrast, and align light/dark card theming with cards 1–3.

[Image 5: 04-zoom-toplangs.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Missing/invisible language rows and critically low contrast: Only two legend items ("TypeScript 45.79%" and "HTML 2.54%", summing to 48.33%) are faintly visible in ultra-pale gray/pastel on white (~1.2:1 contrast); all remaining languages—including the purple language shown in the stacked bar—are completely invisible, leaving the lower half blank (mid-animation capture or broken opacity).

[Image 5: 04-zoom-toplangs.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Truncated/incomplete language bar: The horizontal stacked bar below "Most Used Languages" stops at ~55% of card width (only blue and purple segments rendered), failing to represent the full language breakdown.
[Image 5: 04-zoom-toplangs.png | Verdict: REJECT | Defect] Missing honest-state elements: No observation timestamp, repository scope note, or stale/unavailable indicator is shown.

[Image 5: 04-zoom-toplangs.png | Verdict: REJECT | Opportunity] Disable SVG animations so the complete stacked bar and all language labels render immediately at full opacity and high contrast, and align light/dark theming with cards 1–3.

[Image 6: 05-zoom-streak.png | Verdict: ACCEPT WITH FIXES | Defect] Nearly invisible flame icon: The flame icon inside the top cutout of the orange streak ring is rendered in ultra-pale cream/off-white on white (~1.05:1 contrast), likely caught mid-fade-in animation or with near-zero opacity.

[Image 6: 05-zoom-streak.png | Verdict: ACCEPT WITH FIXES | Defect] Weak contrast on orange accent label: "Current Streak" in bright orange on white has sub-AA contrast (~2.4:1) for normal-size text, hurting readability when scaled down to README width (~350–760px).

[Image 6: 05-zoom-streak.png | Verdict: ACCEPT WITH FIXES | Defect] Incomplete honest-state elements: Although date ranges ("Jul 21, 2024 - Present", "May 5, 2026 - Nov 24") imply recency, there is no explicit observation timestamp (time + timezone) or stale/unavailable indicator.

[Image 6: 05-zoom-streak.png | Verdict: ACCEPT WITH FIXES | Opportunity] Three-column layout, vertical dividers, and dark-slate numerals/dates are clean with zero overlaps. Disabling animation on the flame icon, darkening the orange accent slightly (and toning down the glow around "204"), and matching dark/light theme with cards 1–3 would further improve polish.

verdict.summary: Per-image verdicts — Image 1 (00-zoom-activity.png, activity card): REJECT; Image 2 (01-zoom-presence.png, Discord presence chip): ACCEPT; Image 3 (02-zoom-current.png, in-progress projects card): REJECT; Image 4 (03-zoom-stats.png, stats card): REJECT; Image 5 (04-zoom-toplangs.png, top-langs card): REJECT; Image 6 (05-zoom-streak.png, streak card): ACCEPT WITH FIXES. Four of six cards fail visual quality due to severe text/box overlaps (activity, current), missing required weight labels (current), or broken mid-animation/near-invisible renders (stats, top-langs). Presence is clean and shippable; streak is structurally solid but needs flame-icon visibility, orange-label contrast, and explicit observation-timestamp fixes.
